The texture of the bandage backing is visible, showing a woven or perforated fabric structure.

The drawn lines do not sit perfectly on the surface texture; they appear to bleed into the fabric weave unnaturally. The geometry of the drawn character is nonsensical and structurally ambiguous, suggesting an AI struggle with rendering coherent 2D art on a 3D textured surface.
